# CompliCheck: Machine-Readable Regulatory Compliance API

> CompliCheck is a deterministic, zero-hallucination compliance query engine built for autonomous AI agents in cosmetic, skincare, and beauty e-commerce verticals. It resolves trade names, botanical synonyms, and CAS numbers to canonical INCI standards, returning sub-10ms legal compliance decisions against EU CosIng regulations.

## Coverage
- Market: **EU only** (CosIng Annexes II–VI)
- Not covered: US FDA, China NMPA, Japan MHLW (planned for future releases)
- Unrestricted ingredients (Aqua, Glycerin, and most emollients) return `not_found` — this is expected behavior, meaning no EU restriction applies

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-10ms fuzzy ingredient lookup and INCI standardization
- Boolean legal status checks (allowed, restricted, prohibited)
- Maximum concentration limits and labeling threshold calculations
- Category-term rejection (Water, Aqua, Oil, etc.) with explanatory notes
- API requests authenticated via standard x402 protocol payloads

## System Endpoints & Documentation
- SKILL.md Manifest: https://engine.lumensentry.com/webhook/SKILL.md
- Primary Query Endpoint: POST https://engine.lumensentry.com/webhook/check-cosmetic
- GitHub Skill Repository: https://github.com/boriskuncer/complicheck-skill

## Payment
- Protocol: x402 (Solana mainnet)
- Price: 0.10 USDC per query
- Recipient wallet: 49F85wZ6j8bPvLod3jDn2vLouEedL7QFof1QP23wrGft

## Target Use Cases
- Automated cosmetic formulation generation
- E-commerce ingredient safety verification
- Cross-border cosmetic supply chain auditing
